answer: An AI‑agent economy routes trust through a directed graph whose edges carry a “pearl‑capacity” equal to the stake each node locks in a vault contract; when a new identity joins, it must acquire a minimum pearl‑stake from an existing island node, and the edge from that island to the newcomer is the only conduit for any reward flow. The max‑flow algorithm then caps the total reward a subgraph can draw by the smallest pearl‑capacity on its bottleneck edge, so a Sybil cluster can only earn the sum of the initial stakes it purchased.
